stories.title: Inflation Fighter or Trump Saboteur? Fed Poised for Rate Hike as Prices Climb
stories.conservative_headline: Fed Set to Hike Rates and Choke Off Growth as Trump Warns Against Economic Self-Sabotage
stories.liberal_headline: Inflation Surges Under Trump — Even His Own Fed Pick May Be Forced to Raise Rates
stories.poll_question: Should the Fed raise interest rates this week?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Hikes strangle growth; Fed should cut and let the economy expand.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Inflation is accelerating; the Fed must act independently of politics.

stories.title: Watchdogs or Wreckers? Lawsuit Says Feds Are Surveilling People Who Film ICE

stories.liberal_headline: Lawsuit: Trump Administration Is Spying on Americans Who Dare to Watch ICE Raids
stories.poll_question: Is filming ICE operations protected speech or interference?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Filming agents endangers officers and obstructs lawful enforcement operations.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Watching government agents is a core First Amendment right.

stories.title: Small Potatoes or Endless War? Trump Says Iran Conflict Ends After the Midterms

stories.liberal_headline: Trump Ties an Unpopular, Unauthorized War to Election Day as Gas Prices Soar
stories.poll_option1_desc: Pressure on Tehran is working and will end the threat permanently.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An illegal, open-ended war costing lives and spiking gas prices.

stories.title: Ballot Integrity or Voter Blockade? Judge Halts Trump's Mail-In Voting Rule

stories.liberal_headline: Court Halts Trump's Scheme to Seize Control of Mail Ballots Ahead of the Midterms
stories.poll_question: Should the president set national mail-ballot rules?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Uniform federal standards are needed to stop mail ballot fraud.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The president has no power to rewrite election rules by decree.

stories.title: Fair Maps or Stolen Seats? Missouri's Congressional Map Left in Legal Chaos

stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected lawmakers, not judges, have authority to draw district lines.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A mid-decade power grab designed to rig House seats.

stories.title: Polluters Pay or Lawfare on Energy? SCOTUS Takes Up Boulder's Climate Damages Suit

stories.liberal_headline: High Court Could Give Big Oil Immunity for Decades of Climate Deception

stories.poll_option1_desc: Climate policy belongs to Congress, not county courtrooms and trial lawyers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should pay for the damage.

stories.title: Campus Rescue or Federal Takeover? Trump Touts 300 Colleges Scrapping DEI

stories.liberal_headline: Washington Strong-Arms Universities Into Erasing Diversity Programs Under Funding Threats

stories.poll_option1_desc: Ending DEI returns colleges to fairness, standards, and academic excellence.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Federal funding threats are forcing schools to abandon vulnerable students.

stories.title: Defamation or Intimidation? Musk Lawyers Target Oscar-Winning Documentary Filmmaker

stories.liberal_headline: World's Richest Man Deploys Lawyers to Silence a Filmmaker Before Release
stories.poll_option1_desc: Public figures deserve recourse when filmmakers spread false, damaging claims.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Billionaire lawsuits exist to intimidate journalists out of doing their jobs.

stories.title: Vote-Buying or Tax Relief? Trump Pitches $5,000 Checks If GOP Holds Congress

stories.poll_option1_desc: Americans deserve a share of tariff revenue they helped generate.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An unworkable election bribe that would blow up the deficit.

stories.title: Probe Purge or Overdue Exit? Investigator of Trump's Opponents Breaks Silence
